 Snow Crab Flavoured Surimi Stick Recalled For Egg and Soy
 November 4, 2026 by Linda Larsen 
 Snow Crab Flavoured Surimi Stick is being recall e d in Canada because it contains egg and soy, two of the major food allergens in that country, that are not declared on the product label as required. Anyone who is allergic to or sensitive to those ingredients could have a serious reaction if they eat this product. No illnesses or adverse reactions have been reported to the company to date in connection with the consumption of this product. The recalling firm is Ecological Park Agriculture Inc.
 This item was sold at the retail level in the province of British Columbia. The recalled product is Snow Crab Flavoured Surimi Stick that is packaged in 200 gram pouches. There is no brand name for this product. The recalled product has Chinese characters only. The UPC number that is stamped on the product label is 6 926104 942661. And the codes for this item are 20260802, 20270201, and J016 D02. You can see another picture of this product at the Canadian Food Inspection Agency web site.
 If you purchased this product and cannot consume egg and/or soy, do not eat it. You can throw it away in a secure trash can with a tight fitting lid after first double bagging or wrapping the item so other people can’t see it, or you can take it back to the store where you bought it for a full refund.
